curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with obeying signals and officers, then steady and flashing red, steady and flashing yellow, flashing yellow left arrows, steady green, and green arrows.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per signal rule; contrast cards for steady versus flashing red, steady versus flashing yellow, and green ball versus green arrow.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a signal and asking what the driver must do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the four jobs signs do, then the color code and the shape code, and how warning signs call for slowing.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for sign purposes, colors and shapes; a contrast card pairing colors with shapes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a color or shape and asking what it means.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the warning signs for signals ahead, clearances, divided highways, added lanes, curves, side roads, rough and wet surfaces, and lane reductions, and the slowing they call for.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each group of warnings; a contrast card tying every curve warning to slowing and no passing.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a warning and asking the right response.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the junction, merge, pedestrian, school, surface, bridge, truck, downgrade, ramp meter, and animal warnings and how to respond to each.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each group of warnings; a contrast card separating junction warnings from surface warnings.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a described warning tells the driver to do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain that regulatory signs carry the force of law, then lane-use, stop, speed, passing, school zone, work zone, all-way stop, and center-lane rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each group of regulations; contrast cards for stop signs versus advisory speeds and all-way stops versus protected arrows and center lanes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a regulation and asking what it requires.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover guide signs and route markers, railroad advance signs, crossbucks and emergency notification signs, and lane-use control signals.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for railroad signs and guide signs; a contrast card for red crosses versus green arrows over lanes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a railroad or guide sign tells the driver.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach rail gate behavior, center and lane lines, center turn lanes, yellow and white lines, crosswalks and stop lines.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each marking rule; contrast cards for broken versus solid lines and single versus double solid white.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a marking and asking what a driver may do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain crash barrels, hearing-impaired flags, orange work-zone devices and doubled fines, channelizing devices, barricade stripes, flaggers, and the penalties for ignoring signs and misusing slow-moving emblems.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each work-zone rule and the penalties; contrast cards for stripe direction and flagger stops.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a driver does in a described work zone.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec05-m01..sec05-m08; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
